fig_deletion.notes: TEST, K* = 32, 3 seeds (0, 1, 2), all from T7-3SEEDS.json. (a) survivor corners of each scope: store survivors_before (open) / survivors_after (filled, the downdated store); each rival as_trained_novel_per_corner_on_the_scopes_survivors (open) / retrain_without_novel_per_corner (filled); bar = mean of 3 seeds, dots = seeds. The vacuous red-AND-cube scope (0 rows) is not drawn. (b)/(c) value scope: store OUR_ADAPTATION_COST, the store's refit-without reference, and each rival's retrain_without_cost; rows read are identical across seeds (asserted). Rivals are fit on 16,384 rows; the store on its 131,072-row pool. Exactness is store-scoped; adaptation is light and data-free, never 'no change'.

fig_encoder_adapt.notes: 3 seeds x 3 configurations = 9 arm-runs (3 SEEDS). Margin = single design - best learned baseline (mlp_180k, chosen per arm); a DIFFERENT opponent from the ladder's learned 1x, so this figure is never merged with fig_ladder. Equal compute: 400 steps / 25,600 images per arm-run (printed in CROSS-ARM.md).

fig_ladder.notes: 3 seeds (0, 1, 2) on every rung; line = mean of the three per-seed values, open dots = seeds. One panel per landed rival column set (data/ladder_rival_sets.json), each beside the same store (KSTAR-LADDER.json by_rung.*.kstar_K32.store) and table floor (LADDER.csv rival_table). Sets drawn: combination_split_32256: Read-path rivals, 32,256-row pool (combination-split pool; carries the held-out values); source w12-composition-ladder/LADDER.csv; data_matched_mlp_32768: Data-matched MLP, 32,768-row pool (the store's own content rows of each rung); source w12-composition-ladder/LADDER.csv. Pool sizes asserted from each set's own artefact. For n >= 3 the rungs probe the identical 120 corners: a fit-pool coverage axis, not a depth axis. The Learned-1x stress opponent is not drawn (it is not the paper's matching rule). Asserted: the store exceeds every drawn rival on every rung and seed.
rival_sets_not_landed: data_matched_131072 (131,072 rows): w20 shapes-data-matched (the four naive units refit on 131,072 rows); no artefact on this machine at build time

fig_maze_conditions.notes: CMAZE-T condition table, primary row unseen n-way (exact judge), n = 3 seeds per row. Per-seed markers for the CLU and for R* (the matched rival with the highest 3-seed mean over every kind and both budgets); tick = 3-seed mean. Label = the Head's rule (PREREG-w21-words-full-test.md), computed by head_label() from each row's BARS artefact; asserted equal to HEAD_LABEL where the artefact carries one (WORDS-FULL TEST). No numeric margin bar is drawn. The observation-rival row is labelled ASYMMETRIC (rivals read a 636-dim observation, the CLU the 318-wide word design) and carries no claim label. Rows are read from data/maze_conditions.json in order.

fig_maze_readverb.notes: CMAZE-2b only (w14 request layer, GRID_REBASED budgets), TEST, 3 seeds; bar = mean of the three per-seed values, dots = seeds. MERGE = MERGE_target_wins (the arm, per w14-read-verb/TABLES.md). This is an INTERFACE (verb) result: the same merge lifts the matched-bytes lookup floor more than the CLU and the charter-C controls do NOT collapse, so no store row is claimed. The lookup floor's ~0.97 is the WITHIN-MAZE floor that cannot transfer across mazes.
